item.title: Earlier projects
item.description:
About this project catalogue

Here is, in alphabetical order, a collection of some of my work I had completed over time. I’ve done other stuff that either, failed so hard that I rather forget about or stuff I’ve actually forgotten at this point. Since some of the software files may no longer be functional due to outdated libraries and since AI coding is so good that it’s probably easier to just ask Claude to build it again, that I won’t link those. If you’re interested, contact me.
